description: Source code for managing Type 1 font objects in the FreeType project, including size, glyph slot, face, and driver functions.

methods.name: T1_Size_Get_Globals_Funcs
methods.description: Retrieves global hinting functions for a given size.

methods.name: T1_Size_Done
methods.description: Finalizes a size object, destroying associated global hints.

methods.name: T1_Size_Init
methods.description: Initializes a size object, creating global hints.

methods.name: T1_Size_Request
methods.description: Requests metrics for a size, setting scale via hinting functions.

methods.name: T1_GlyphSlot_Done
methods.description: Finalizes a glyph slot, clearing glyph hints.

methods.name: T1_GlyphSlot_Init
methods.description: Initializes a glyph slot, setting up hinting functions.

methods.name: T1_Face_Done
methods.description: Destructor for a face object, freeing font data and resources.

methods.name: T1_Face_Init
methods.description: Constructor for a face object, loading font data and setting face properties.
